newsitem.title: USA: Tandy to sell chain, close 19 stores.
newsitem.headline: Tandy to sell chain, close 19 stores.

text.p: Tandy Corp said Monday it would sell its 17-store Incredible Universe chain, and close 19 Computer City stores in North America and relocate two others, resulting in a roughly $170 million charge to earnings in the 1996 fourth quarter.
Tandy previously said it would take an after-tax charge of more than $20 million to discontinue its McDuff stores.
It said the phase-out of the Incredible Universe chain will take about six months.
The company has 108 Computer City stores in North America.
Tandy said it is anticipated that essentially all charges related to the Computer City plans will be recognized in the year ending tomorrow.

The company said it has not finalized its review of costs associated with its strategic moves, but preliminary estimates of such costs are on the order of $170 million after-tax and will be recognized in the fourth quarter of 1996.

Computer City stores being closed are located in California (eight stores), North Carolina (one), Ohio (one), Washington D.C. (three), Maryland (two), Massachusetts (one), Texas (one), New Jersey (one) and Pennsylvania (one).
